facts.fact: Clay 当面质问 Ares 对 Kayla 做了什么，Ares 回答「Nothing she didn’t consent to」，并称那只是「a physical response, a natural progression」的「isolated incident」，拒绝为此做 debrief

facts.fact: Vero 拍桌而起反驳 Ares，说 Kayla「is a person, and she is our person」，用 our 而非 his
facts.anchor: “She is not an isolated incident.” Vero’s voice cracks. “She is a person, and she is our person.”

facts.fact: Vero 逼 Ares 说出真心话并表明立场「I have always known who you are, and I love you anyway」，Brawley 因此绷紧身体
facts.anchor: I have always known who you are, and I love you anyway, the same way as you see me and love me.

facts.fact: Brawley 指责 Ares 引发这一切，指到 Kayla 的电话与腕带，并说「if Kayla didn’t call to you, there is no way you would have agreed to wear that wristband」
facts.anchor: “You better fix it, because you have caused this spiral. When someone gets hurt, it’s on you. Deny it all you like, but if Kayla didn’t call to you, there is no way you would have agreed to wear that wristband, whether or not you fucked her while wearing it.”

facts.fact: Vero 发短信向 Clay 要 Kayla 的照片，Clay 拍下并发给他并回「She’s okay」，Vero 回「I just needed to see it」
facts.anchor: Snapping a picture before I can think about whether I should drag her out of here, I send it to Vero and type underneath it.

facts.fact: Clay 跟踪酒吧里盯梢 Kayla 的男人到后巷，把他按在砖墙上并威胁他不许再出现，最后打断其鼻梁
facts.anchor: I approach silently behind him and take him by the back of the collar, using my hold to slam him face-first into the brick wall beside the door.

facts.fact: Kayla 对 Clay 说「Thank you」，这是她第一次道谢
facts.anchor: “Thank you,” she finally says, which shocks me and leaves me at a loss for words.
